record.title: Uganda closure of Bunagana and Ishasha adjoining M23-held territory
record.scope: Selected Ugandan crossings adjoining eastern DRC; separately, Goma-bound goods clearance via the named Uganda–Rwanda and Uganda–DRC routes
record.movement: Formal passenger/trade operations in the original phases; separately, goods heading to Goma via the four March3 clearance routes. Small-truck local exports and heavy international freight had different August4 access.
record.exceptions: Previously reviewed informal Bunagana movement continued. March3 goods could be declared through unaffected posts; August4 reporting confirms small-truck local trade while heavy international traffic remained limited.
record.imposing_authority: Ugandan border authorities; reopening by presidential directive
record.enforcement: Original phases retain official permission/ceremony evidence. The August4 named mayor confirms small trucks crossing at Bunagana, without a first-passage day or heavy international restoration. The March3 URA directive is a reported formal clearance rule; named URA confirmation does not itself establish physical post closure.
record.status_observation: Formal reactivation/permission in July2025; limited Bunagana small-truck local trade confirmed by August4. No universal operational reopening or endpoint for the separate March goods-clearance rule established.
record.official_rationale: Initial formal justification not recovered; reporting links closure to M23 advance. Reopening authorities criticised closure as counterproductive.
record.uncertainty: Exact late January onset unknown. Official reactivation at Bunagana and Ishasha on 10 July; reopening permission for Busanza on 9 July, with actual first passage unverified. Informal movement at Bunagana continued.
